The '''Klorri-clan battle shield''',<ref name="VD" /> sometimes also simply called a '''Wookiee Staff''',<ref name="BftG">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> was a traditional [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|shield]] used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="VD" /> The shields were passed down through generations<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Klorri-Clan Battle Shield}}</ref> and could be dated back to two [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the formation of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and at that time were usually only displayed during rituals and ceremonies. The shields were carved symbolic motifs and decorated with green gemstones and were banded with [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]].<ref name="VD" /> At the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] various Wookiee warriors used Klorri-clan battle shields in the fight against the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] at the [[Beach/Legends|beach]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="Ep3" /> The Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] also wielded one such shield as part of the battle.<ref name="Unleashed">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Unleashed|pack=Chewbacca {{C|2005 edition}}}}</ref>
